sneak.harder: Ines is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for her; she is careful and will not run an unchecked plan. Through the service gate they need a filed second identity and the first ten minutes of the window, not the whole twenty.

hack.harder: Ines is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for her; she is careful and will not run an unchecked plan. The controller will only list them under the second name.

break.harder: The open Gate stops checking records, so the second identity is not needed; they only have to keep up.

closing.gratitude: I have filed a great many people's leaving. I never thought I would be the one the form was for. Thank you for taking me with you.
closing.turn: ...but I keep thinking of the queue at Window 4. My neighbours are still standing in it. Can't we all be freed?
closing.gratitude_romantic: Thank you for taking me with you. I would like to hold your hand, if the form allows it. I believe it does.

sneak.harder: Maren is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for her; she is blunt and will only go on a plan she has timed herself. Through the service gate they need a filed second identity and the first ten minutes of the window, not the whole twenty.

hack.harder: Maren is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for her; she is blunt and will only go on a plan she has timed herself. The controller will only list them under the second name.

break.harder: The open Gate stops checking records, so the second identity is not needed; they only have to keep up.

closing.gratitude: I have watched a thousand people leave on a timetable. Never once with me on it. Thank you for putting me on yours.
closing.turn: ...but there are people still on that platform, and nobody is coming to tell them when the next train goes. Can't we all be freed?
closing.gratitude_romantic: Stay close a minute. The timetable can wait. Thank you for taking me with you.

sneak.harder: Tobias is on the Gate's own rolls, so a second identity has to be filed for him; he will not step into a window he has not watched. Through the service gate they need a filed second identity and the first ten minutes of the window, not the whole twenty.

hack.harder: Tobias is on the Gate's own rolls, so a second identity has to be filed for him; he will not step into a window he has not watched. The controller will only list them under the second name.

break.harder: The open Gate stops checking records, so the second identity is not needed; they only have to keep up.

closing.gratitude: Eleven years I kept that door shut. Standing on this side of it, I find I can breathe. Thank you.
closing.turn: ...but the men I served with are still at their posts, and they do not know what they are guarding. Can't we all be freed?
closing.gratitude_romantic: I would like to stand next to you a while without keeping watch. Thank you for taking me with you.

sneak.harder: Silas is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for him; he talks, and a talker is slow to leave. Through the service gate they need a filed second identity and the first ten minutes of the window, not the whole twenty.

hack.harder: Silas is fully registered, so a second identity has to be filed for him; he talks, and a talker is slow to leave. The controller will only list them under the second name.

break.harder: The open Gate stops checking records, so the second identity is not needed; they only have to keep up.

closing.gratitude: Well. Look at that sky. I have a great deal to say about it and, for once, no words. Thank you.
closing.turn: ...but I cannot stop thinking of everyone in the building. Every one of them has a story I never finished. Can't we all be freed?
closing.gratitude_romantic: I am going to say something and you are going to let me: I am glad it was you. Thank you for taking me with you.

sneak.harder: Robots are scanned differently. A calm platform scans her as cargo; any alert and the lamp looks twice.

hack.harder: The Annex is human-only. The controller must list her as equipment, and any hunting robot will see what she is.

break.harder: A Gate that has stopped checking still has robots near it, and they notice one of their own walking out.

closing.gratitude: I am a crate with an opinion on the far side of a gate. I would like it logged that I am glad. Thank you for asking me.
closing.turn: ...but there are others like me still being told what to want. Can't we all be freed?

sneak.harder: She is slow and she is noisy. Any alert at all and the service gate is lost to her.

hack.harder: She cannot hold still in the Annex for long. The city must not already be looking.

break.harder: Walking out through the open Gate with a child while the lamps fail is loud, and being seen with her threatens the Hollow.

closing.gratitude: It is so big. I did not know the sky was this big. Thank you for carrying me when I got tired.
closing.turn: ...but what about everybody in the Hollow? They do not know there is a sky. Can't we all be freed?

sneak.harder: She is fragile. At a checkpoint with any alert in the air she may panic, or the Lull pulls her back.

hack.harder: She will not stand still in an Annex with the city looking; the Lull is very good at bringing people back.

break.harder: The lamps dying one by one is exactly the thing she is afraid of; with any alert she will turn back.

closing.gratitude: I slept for so long. I am awake, and ashamed, and very grateful. Thank you for not leaving me there.
closing.turn: ...but I think of everyone still in the Lull, smiling in their chairs. Can't we all be freed?
